g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn =
decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none,
e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle
